faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Albany?
faq.answer: Albany homeowners typically invest $4,500 to $9,500 for a full window replacement project, covering 8–12 windows in the city's characteristic bungalows and craftsman homes. Single window pricing starts around $500 installed. Homes on Albany Hill with larger windows or more complex configurations may see higher totals.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Albany?
faq.answer: Yes. Albany requires a building permit for window replacements that involve altering the rough opening size or structural framing. Like-for-like replacements of the same size may qualify for an over-the-counter permit. Our team handles the permit process on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Albany?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Albany commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Albany?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Albany replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Albany?
faq.answer: Most Albany projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
